name: bidcraft
description: Task runner for BidCraft (replaces make -- npm is installed everywhere, make is not, notably on Windows without extra tooling).

scripts.test:integration: docker compose --profile test up -d db-test && cd backend && go test -tags=integration ./internal/repository/...
scripts.fmt: cd backend && go fmt ./... && cd ../frontend && npx prettier -w src --log-level warn
